outputComponents.text:
I've updated the **Closed Tasks** screen with the following interactive prototype links:

- **Settings Gear**: Tapping the gear icon in the top right now navigates to the **Settings** screen.
- **Task Cards**: All task cards for completed work are now clickable and link to the **Task Details** view.
- **Bottom Navigation**: Tapping the **Inbox** island button will return you to your active task list.

The visual design, including the Beltelecom brand colors, task layout, and Russian localization, has been strictly preserved. You can now test the full navigation flow in the prototype preview.
